newsitem.title: USA: CFTC views CME feeder limit increase favorably.
newsitem.headline: CFTC views CME feeder limit increase favorably.

text.p: The U.S. Commodity Futures Trading Commission indicated Wednesday it is viewing favorably an application by the CME to raise speculative position limits for feeder cattle contracts.

"It appears that it is consistent with current policy," said Paul Architzel, chief counsel at CFTC's economic analysis division. Architzel was speaking at a public meeting of the CFTC's Agricultural Advisory Committee.
The Chicago Mercantile Exchange applied September 13 to raise speculative position limits to 1,000 contracts from 750 contracts.
